brandGuidelines.title: Logo Clear Space
brandGuidelines.rule: Always maintain adequate clear space around the logo. Nothing should intrude within this protected zone.
brandGuidelines.doExample: Logo with adequate breathing room on all sides, nothing within the clearspace zone.
brandGuidelines.dontExample: Logo crowded by text, borders, or other design elements within the clearspace.

brandGuidelines.title: Logo on Photography
brandGuidelines.rule: When placing the logo on photography, ensure sufficient contrast. Use white or black version depending on the background.
brandGuidelines.doExample: White logo on dark photography with clear visibility and contrast.
brandGuidelines.dontExample: Color logo on busy, mid-tone photography where it becomes hard to read.

brandGuidelines.title: Color Application
brandGuidelines.rule: Use brand colors consistently and purposefully. Primary color should dominate; secondary colors should accent.
brandGuidelines.doExample: Primary color used for main brand elements, secondary as accents on appropriate backgrounds.
brandGuidelines.dontExample: Random color mixing or using off-brand colors that dilute the brand identity.

brandGuidelines.title: Typography Pairing
brandGuidelines.rule: Always pair the display font for headings with the body font for paragraphs. Never use the display font for extended body copy.
brandGuidelines.doExample: Display font headline with body font paragraph text below.
brandGuidelines.dontExample: Display font used for body copy or long-form content.

brandGuidelines.title: Logo Modifications
brandGuidelines.rule: Never modify the logo by stretching, rotating, adding effects, or changing colors outside approved variations.
brandGuidelines.doExample: Logo used in approved color variations at correct proportions.
brandGuidelines.dontExample: Logo stretched, outlined, shadowed, tilted, or recolored in unapproved ways.
